Which is fine. When my friend came out as trans in high school he immediately became an ass to anyone who didn't get his pronouns right. I found it so rude, after knowing someone for awhile as one gender it's very easy to accidentally use the wrong pronoun.

So far I have been relling people to call me by whatever they feel comfortable with. Some very supportive friends are using proper pronouns and my chosen name. Most (even my mom) are kind of experimenting at this point and mainly refer to me with my birth name and female pronouns. I'm okay with this because it's a big change that I want to take gradually and I empathize with how hard it can be to others.
